commits: perf(codegen): defer dead-slot clears to collecting blocks; skip stored prologue words
perf(codegen): read block-local slot loads in place instead of copying them

changes.deadSlotDeferral: A slot dying at a block entry is zeroed at the next block that may collect (closed-IR safepoint proof), unless stored first; blocks proven free of safepoints clear nothing.
changes.slotLoadAliasing: A load whose slot is not stored before the result last use in its block (and not named by a cell terminator or written by a record terminator it feeds) reads the slot word in place: no copy, no private home, no temporary root.
changes.prologueSlotProof: Slot words every path stores before any collection or read of them are not zeroed in the prologue (must-write dataflow; handlers inherit block entry state; throw counts as a collection).

bugsFoundAndFixed: slot-load alias state machine: a second store to the slot re-admitted a load already used after the first store (postfix-increment shape); found by bisecting the self-compile ("invalid or duplicate value ID") to one function, then checking all aliases against a brute-force oracle; seeded random oracle test added
prologue proof: signed bitset AND compared against Uint32Array contents never converged (always exhausted the budget); covered by a 40-word loop test
